notes: NSH 0.2.0 GTK4 backend, Rust-only app (no QuickJS). Frame end = GdkFrameClock after-paint on the GTK main thread (last public post-render signal: GSK render done, X11 frame submitted; presentation not reported without a compositor). Only frames whose snapshot ran again (a widget was invalidated: mounted batch, scroll, native animation) are counted; paints that redrew nothing go to ops.paints_without_change. Pacing 60: GdkFrameClock's own 60 Hz timer; no public NSH/GTK app API unpaces it (BENCH_PACING=uncapped -> 60-only; GTK's debug option GDK_DEBUG=no-vsync only adds empty repaints and starves NSH's batches; GDK_DEBUG=(unset)). Rust components run on the NSH engine thread, GTK on the main thread, one batch hop per commit. Warm-up 2 s excluded. GSK_RENDERER=cairo.
version: nsh-core/nsh-base/nsh-platform-linux 0.2.0 (crates.io, = git tag v0.2.0 669b62b); gtk4-rs 0.11.5; GTK 4.14.5 (system, runtime); rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13)
